info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Capture-v2-spec
info.description: The Payments Capture API facilitates the secure processing of payment capture transactions for business services. This endpoint allows merchants to finalize payment processes for previously authorized transactions, ensuring funds are transferred while providing a seamless experience for end-users. Ideal for e-commerce platforms and financial service providers, this API is essential for managing real-time payment operations and maintaining transaction integrity. It enables efficient communication between backend systems and payment gateways, allowing for timely updates and confirmations.

post.description: This operation captures a previously authorized payment transaction. It finalizes the transaction process and allows the funds to be transferred from the buyer to the seller. Ensure that the payment is authorized before attempting to capture.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to capture a payment that has been previously authorized. It contains the necessary information to process the transaction successfully.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsCaptureRequest.title: Capture Payment Request

amount.description: The amount of money to be captured.

currency.description: The currency in which the payment is made.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon completion.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment request is made.
